<br>
使用Windows11系统进行操作<br>
刷机的手机型号是Pixel 2，在设置-&gt;系统-&gt;开发者选项，打开开发者选项。<br>
然后在这个页面向下滑，打开USB调式。<br>
要想刷机OEM锁必须解开。谷歌海外版的Pixel 2的OEM锁是可以在开发者选项中解开的，而Verizon (V版)是不能解开的。并且还必须是欧版的，因为美版的bootloader锁是解不开的。<br>
如果没有开发者选项可以在 设置-&gt;关于手机中找到版本号连击5次开启开发者模式即可<br>
<strong>工具安装</strong><strong>安装platform-tools</strong><br>
在浏览器打开连接：https://googledownloads.cn/android/repository/platform-tools-latest-windows.zip然后解压：<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_K5eEk" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_HRS5PT9WJ9EGFS5.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_HRS5PT9WJ9EGFS5.jpg"></font><br>
将该目录添加到环境变量中，右击文件夹里的此电脑<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_c11fs" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_KVEYXT8ZJN7YGJE.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_KVEYXT8ZJN7YGJE.jpg"></font><br>
点击属性-&gt;高级系统设置-&gt;环境变量，找到系统变量中的path<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_eViN8" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_N93MJJHM5CCFHPS.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_N93MJJHM5CCFHPS.jpg"></font><br>
点击编辑-&gt;新建，然后将目录路径复制进去<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_BKR4P" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_RG3T8G278WSC5VW.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_RG3T8G278WSC5VW.jpg"></font><br>
然后点击确定-&gt;确定-&gt;确定<br>
<strong>安装谷歌USB驱动</strong><br>
<br>
使用浏览器访问链接：https://dl.google.com/android/repository/usb_driver_r13-windows.zip，下载Google USB驱动，解压这个压缩包<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_svzOR" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_KBC4CDHAUNKX5U3.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_KBC4CDHAUNKX5U3.jpg"></font><br>
使用数据线将要刷机的手机和电脑链接起来。<br>
接下来访问https://zhuanlan.zhihu.com/p/366904302，这是一个安装谷歌USB驱动的教程。<br>
不过要划到下面这个地方开始看：<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_vBk3U" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_YD782ANDVKEYCYX.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_YD782ANDVKEYCYX.jpg"></font><br>
<strong>下载系统包</strong><br>
访问：https://developers.google.com/android/images?hl=zh-cn，找到对应自己手机型号的系统<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_X7Fb8" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_FH38RAABMR7N32T.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_FH38RAABMR7N32T.jpg"></font><br>
注意要找那些高于或等于手机原来系统版本的系统包。<br>
这是因为系统版本越高，bootloader的版本也会越高，而bootloader是不允许降级的，从而导致无法刷机。<br>
查看手机的系统版本：点击设置-&gt;关于手机然后划到最后面的"版本号"，就是手机系统的版本<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_s8BDY" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_WU386S9D2HF7ENP.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_WU386S9D2HF7ENP.jpg"></font><br>
将下载的压缩包解压：<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_kfkRu" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_UA5KKU4SQ5N4H9R.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_UA5KKU4SQ5N4H9R.jpg"></font><br>
<strong>刷入系统包</strong><strong>让手机进入fastboot模式</strong><br>
使用命令：adb devices，查看电脑是否链接了手机<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_i9Mmq" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_8VWDAKZY4CDQZSZ.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_8VWDAKZY4CDQZSZ.jpg"></font><br>
链接上手机使用命令：adb reboot bootloader，让手机进入fastboot模式，手机会变成下面这个样子，而且这个命令需要执行一段时间，执行完之后，手机就会变成这样。<br>
或者长按开机键和减音量键<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_R9009" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_TGAWNWZ775EMGX5.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_TGAWNWZ775EMGX5.jpg"></font><br>
如果Device State的值是locked，说明bootloader锁没有解开，可以使用命令fastboot oem unclock或fastboot flashing unlock解开bootloader锁。<br>
如果无法解开，说明手机是美版的，是无法解开bootloader锁的。<br>
使用命令：fastbooy devices，查看与进入fastboot模式的手机是否连接正常<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_wkQK2" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_G9YR7W96F6R9NPQ.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_G9YR7W96F6R9NPQ.jpg"></font><br>
<strong>刷机</strong>双击flash-all.bat文件会弹出一个cmd命令窗口，需要等待一段时间让这个脚本执行完。如果最后的结果如下：<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_I9ija" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_ZWR5DQK32GPMBKA.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_ZWR5DQK32GPMBKA.jpg"></font><br>
说明执行成功，然后点任意键退出。再打开一个cmd窗口执行命令：fastboot reboot，重启手机<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_KIQIj" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_83WBNH3DPNQVDA5.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_83WBNH3DPNQVDA5.jpg"></font><br>
这时可能会出现一个警告界面，如下：<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_XvuFF" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_BUFCXYDAXCGSMUU.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_BUFCXYDAXCGSMUU.jpg"></font><br>
这是因为手机的bootloader锁被解开了，系统会提醒你。你会发现手机跟恢复出厂设置了一样，这就说明刷机成功<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_dqAW6" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_YMUQ85GWD7WXW8T.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_YMUQ85GWD7WXW8T.jpg"></font><br>
<strong>使用Magisk获取ROOT权限</strong><strong>安装Magisk</strong><br>
访问：https://github.com/topjohnwu/Magisk/releases，下载Magisk的apk然后开启手机的开发者模式，并启动USB调试。<br>
使用命令：adb install &lt;apk所在位置&gt;，安装Magisk<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_Bd8yL" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_BSSJZ6KJNEAUHNM.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_BSSJZ6KJNEAUHNM.jpg"></font><br>
<strong>修复boot.img</strong><br>
然后进入到上面的那个系统包解压的文件夹里<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_fQ9PG" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_X9QXZ97JTSF7K2F.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_X9QXZ97JTSF7K2F.jpg"></font><br>
将这里的zip文件解压：<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_NSn99" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_39RYW89HBKRE2ZV.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_39RYW89HBKRE2ZV.jpg"></font><br>
然后再该目录下打开cmd窗口，使用命令：adb push boot.img /sdcard/Download，将boot.img文件传入到手机的Download目录里<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_DRonO" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_Y9T49A8CZC2SKQT.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_Y9T49A8CZC2SKQT.jpg"></font>然后启动安装的Magisk<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_V4CDd" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_JHEWPS6H3GSE7DF.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_JHEWPS6H3GSE7DF.jpg"></font><br>
点击安装<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_pM7TU" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_R2HPC8HG8XVTYNV.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_R2HPC8HG8XVTYNV.jpg"></font><br>
点击 选择并修补一个文件：<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_YA093" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_FQJWXPREQPYNQ5P.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_FQJWXPREQPYNQ5P.jpg"></font><br>
然后点击搜索框左边的设置，或者向右划一下屏幕<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_TqFzS" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_PC96NNUGGA9CQKE.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_PC96NNUGGA9CQKE.jpg"></font><br>
点击下载：<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_L88Sj" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_HCGSQ6JKT2B4QDM.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_HCGSQ6JKT2B4QDM.jpg"></font><br>
点击boot.img文件<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_Br6Lc" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_BBDCWJNH9YPHCD4.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_BBDCWJNH9YPHCD4.jpg"></font><br>
点击开始<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_JM56X" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_AHB7Z7AD7AEPJW2.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_AHB7Z7AD7AEPJW2.jpg"></font><br>
出现这个界面的时候说明完成了，然后能可以看到它新生成了一个文件是：/storage/emulated/0/Download/magisk_patched-25201_0juyi.img，你的文件名和我的可能不一样，反正就是一个新的img文件，这个就是修补后的boot.img文件<br>
<strong>刷入修补后的boot.img</strong><br>
在电脑端，使用命令adb pull /storage/emulated/0/Download/magisk_patched-25201_0juyi.img，将该文件拉入到电脑的任意一个目录下<br>
<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_cwEZS" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_QHW8VPSJU8TMYWF.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_QHW8VPSJU8TMYWF.jpg"></font>然后可以看到在该目录下多了一个magisk_patched-25201_0juyi.img文件<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_K2C6M" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_55GFHFW9473Y63Q.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_55GFHFW9473Y63Q.jpg"></font><br>
然后使用命令：adb reboot bootloader，让手机再次进入fastboot模式<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_efIw4" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_HTWSE84TMWPE6G7.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_HTWSE84TMWPE6G7.jpg"></font><br>
然后使用命令：fastboot flash boot magisk_patched-25201_0juyi.img<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_XLEw1" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_UUU3YSJWJXY8Z7J.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_UUU3YSJWJXY8Z7J.jpg"></font><br>
然后按一下手机的开机键重启，重启之后再打开Magisk<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_ape6z" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_NBPHHCRUFRK4VYR.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_NBPHHCRUFRK4VYR.jpg"></font><br>
可以看到超级用户和模块这两个按钮从之前的灰色变成了黑色，与日志一样。并且"当前"的值也不再是无法获取而一个编号，这说明成功获取了root权限。但是你使用adb shell还是无法获取root权限<br>
<strong>Shell获取ROOT权限</strong><br>
打开Magisk，点击超级用户，<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_YLmbz" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_PMU7UVEFVJCB2AY.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_PMU7UVEFVJCB2AY.jpg"></font><br>
将Shell的按钮打开。然后点击主页，<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_mEJG6" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_U4QXUPYQAF6HXVM.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_U4QXUPYQAF6HXVM.jpg"></font><br>
点击右上角的设置，并划到下面的超级用户<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_TBOQh" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_XUEWCEFPX2DAF76.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_XUEWCEFPX2DAF76.jpg"></font><br>
点击"超级用户访问权限"<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_jvwVl" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_567TS8X3CFXZNKB.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_567TS8X3CFXZNKB.jpg"></font><br>
点击"应用和ADB"，然后重启手机重启之后在电脑端的cmd窗口，执行命令：adb shell然后执行：su<br>
<font face="monospace"><img id="aimg_xk8gb" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_SKSBFBYCB2J43UN.jpg" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://bbs.kanxue.com/upload/attach/202509/973331_SKSBFBYCB2J43UN.jpg"></font>可以看到成功获取root权限。<br>
<strong>解决网络连接受限问题</strong><br>
pixel系列的手机在国内使用都会显示网络连接受限，这是因为它无法连接到谷歌服务器，要解决这个问题要么翻墙，要么将它连接的谷歌服务器地址改为国内的服务器地址。<br>
将谷歌服务器地址改为国内的服务器地址的方法是：<br>
adb shell settings put global captive_portal_http_url http://connect.rom.miui.com/generate_204<br>
adb shell settings put global captive_portal_https_url https://connect.rom.miui.com/generate_204<br>
执行这两个命令，然后重启手机即可。</td></tr></tbody></table>
